title: Virtual Compute: snapshot debit — regional protection
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute snapshot debit — When the compute snapshot region differs from the matching backup contract region, multiply the allocated compute-attributable GB-month by that cross-location-protection price; identical regions have no cross-location component. The shared source is compute-managed and the component is included in this one snapshot line, never also billed under backup.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for snapshot debit — regional protection?**

When the compute snapshot region differs from the matching backup contract region, multiply the allocated compute-attributable GB-month by that cross-location-protection price; identical regions have no cross-location component. The shared source is compute-managed and the component is included in this one snapshot line, never also billed under backup.

## Local hypothetical judgement

Hypothetically, compute snapshots and the matching backup contract are both in US East. The cross-location component is zero. If they are in different locations and the attributed quantity is 10 GB-month with a hypothetical protection price of 0.03 USD per GB-month, the unrounded component is 0.30 USD.
